plan.name: Efficient Location-Based Search and Placement
plan.strategy: Use logical location prioritization (e.g., cabinets, fridge, countertops) to locate and cool a pan, then place it on the stoveburner.
steps: Check cabinets first, as pans are often stored there. If no pan is found, proceed to check the fridge and countertops.
If a pan is found, check its temperature. If it is not cool, place it in the fridge to cool.
After the pan is cooled, move it to a stoveburner (e.g., stoveburner 1).
